en.html:
Both men went stiff, as though somebody had driven iron needles into their spines. Then down they went.

Behind them stood the Kubo of Horigoe. A little soot on her, bas.

Unharmed, apparently. Just as I had expected. From the beginning itself I had somehow been certain she had not died in that explosion.

How she had got out, this I could not even imagine. My certainty was managing very comfortably without an explanation.

ja.html:
瞬間、脊椎に鉄針でも打ち込まれたかのように身を
強張らせて、二人の男が<ruby>頽<rt>くずお</rt></ruby>れる。

　心持ち<ruby>煤<rt>すす</rt></ruby>けた堀越公方が、その後方に立っていた。

　やはりと言うべきか、無事だったようだ。
　何とはなし、俺は彼女が爆死を遂げてなどいない事
に最初から確信があった――どうやって死地を逃れた
のか、その方法はまるで想像がつかないのだが。

Chachamaru"Meteor Gang, these fellows."
Kageaki"Meteor... Gang?"
Chachamaru"Naam nahin suna? Never heard?"
Kageaki"My information has not reached that far."
Chachamaru"Arre, their full tamasha started only recently. The papers haven't made a big thing of them yet. Not knowing is probably the normal condition."
Kageaki"A new anti-shogunate terrorist group?"
Chachamaru"Half correct. Matlab, that's half of the correct answer."
Kageaki"The remaining half?"
Chachamaru"Religious group also. That type of arrangement."

en.html:
Kageaki"You mean their objection to shogunate rule is on religious grounds?"
Chachamaru"Ulta. They made overthrowing it their religion... Or it became one by itself, more like. Fairly ordinary anti-shogunate activity at first. Then one particular hero got into their heads."
Chachamaru"Slowly-slowly, hero becomes bhagwan. Whatever bhagwan does, correct only. So they start doing it also. And mubarak ho, now they're extremists sitting near the top of the blacklist."
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Meteor Gang is their own name for themselves. The idol they've appointed for worship—without asking, mind you—is naturally our great mass murderer of the moment."
Chachamaru"Silver Star. The demon king among human beings."

Kageaki"...What absolute bakwaas."
Chachamaru"Achha?"
Kageaki"Overthrowing the shogunate and Silver Star—where is the connection even—"
Chachamaru"Well, in a straight contest of strength, only she can smash our Rokuhara army flat, na. The anti-shogunate crowd sees that and how will the heart not go dhak-dhak?"
Kageaki"Silver Star is not fighting the shogunate. Whoever is there, she kills them. That is all...!"
Chachamaru"In these geniuses' eyes, apparently it becomes 'a heroic battle to hunt down and destroy a great evil, undeterred by a few sacrifices.' Wah."
Kageaki"...Ngh..."

景明「……ッ……」

What bloody nonsense.
Of all the jokes, this was the very worst.
